title: Phonics — Final Assessment
subject: Phonics
description: Grade 2 end-of-year phonics final: vowels, digraphs, blends, vowel pairs, and syllables.

sections.name: Short & Long Vowels
sections.instruction: Listen for the vowel sound. Choose the best answer.

questions.prompt: Which word has a SHORT 'a' sound, like in 'cat'?
questions.hint: Say each word slowly. Short 'a' sounds like the 'a' in cat and bat.

questions.prompt: Which word has a LONG 'e' sound, like in 'bee'?
questions.hint: A long vowel says its own name. Long 'e' sounds like 'eee'.

questions.prompt: Which word has a SHORT 'i' sound in the MIDDLE, like in 'pig'?
questions.hint: Listen to the vowel in the middle. Short 'i' sounds like the 'i' in pin.

questions.prompt: Which word begins with a SHORT vowel sound?
questions.hint: Say each word. Which one starts with a quick vowel sound, not its name?

sections.name: Digraphs & Blends
sections.instruction: Two letters can work together to make one sound. Choose the best answer.

questions.prompt: Which word begins with the 'sh' digraph, like in 'shoe'?
questions.hint: The 'sh' sound is quiet, like when you say 'shh!'

questions.prompt: Which word begins with the 'ch' digraph, like in 'chair'?
questions.hint: The 'ch' sound is like a train: ch-ch-ch.

questions.prompt: Which word begins with the 'th' digraph, like in 'thumb'?
questions.hint: For 'th', put your tongue between your teeth and blow softly.

questions.prompt: Which word begins with a consonant BLEND?
questions.hint: In a blend, you can still hear both letters. Say f-r-og.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank with the 'st' blend to make a word that means the opposite of 'go'. s___p
questions.hint: It starts with the blend 's-t' and rhymes with 'top'.

sections.name: Vowel Pairs
sections.instruction: Some vowels team up to make special sounds. Choose the best answer.

questions.prompt: Which word has the 'ou' sound, like in 'house'?
questions.hint: The 'ou' sound is the one you make when you say 'ouch!'

questions.prompt: Which word has the 'oi' or 'oy' sound, like in 'coin'?
questions.hint: 'oi' and 'oy' make the same sound, like in 'toy' and 'boil'.

questions.prompt: Write the missing letters 'oy' to finish this word. A young man is a b___.
questions.hint: Add 'oy' after the 'b'. It rhymes with 'toy'.

sections.name: Sounds of 'ew' and 'ow'
sections.instruction: The letters 'ew' and 'ow' can make special sounds. Choose the best answer.

questions.prompt: Which word has the 'ew' sound, like in 'new'?
questions.hint: 'ew' sounds like 'oo'. New and flew rhyme.

questions.prompt: Which word has the same 'ow' sound as 'cow'?
questions.hint: 'ow' can sound like 'ouch'. Which word makes that sound, not the long 'o' in snow?

sections.name: Counting Syllables
sections.instruction: Clap out the word parts to count the syllables. Choose the best answer.

questions.prompt: How many syllables are in the word 'butterfly'?
questions.hint: Clap as you say it: but-ter-fly. Count each clap.
